result.title: VitronEdit: Universal Visual Editing across Images, Videos, and 3D Scenes
result.summary: Recent advances in unified visual editing have begun to consolidate image and video editing within a single model, while 3D scene editing remains largely separate and constrained by scarce paired training data. Given the rich image and video editing supervision now available and the common editing semantics shared across modalities, a natural question is whether this knowledge can be transferred to data-scarce 3D editing. We present VitronEdit, a universal framework for image, video, and 3D scene editing. VitronEdit adopts a shared sequence representation and progressive multimodal training to transfer editing knowledge across modalities. We further introduce geometry-aware post-training, which leverages a pretrained geometry reconstruction model to provide depth and camera-pose supervision. Surprisingly, applying geometric supervision only to 3D samples yields the best overall performance, while image and video editing also improve despite receiving no direct geometric supervision, suggesting that geometric regularization transfers through the shared backbone. Our analysis further shows that image and video training mainly transfers editing semantics to 3D, whereas 3D supervision primarily improves multi-view consistency. The project page: https://vitron-llm.github.io/VitronEdit/.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VitronEdit 统一框架，用共享序列表示与渐进式多模态训练，把图像、视频的编辑监督迁移到数据稀缺的 3D 场景编辑，并加入几何感知后训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作聚焦图像、视频与 3D 场景的视觉内容编辑生成，未涉及推理状态、证据筛选或停止决策，其跨模态共享主干与几何正则也无可核查的 LVR 借鉴线索。
